page.biography.title: About Artiani
page.biography.body:
Artiani is a father-and-son collaboration — a shared vision of artist Levan Margiani and Giorgi Margiani, inspired by Levan’s miniatures and dedicated to bringing us closer to that astonishing world we call art.

Here, selected works by Levan Margiani are transformed into tangible forms: tablecloths, bags, runners, decorative pillows, headscarves, and other objects that add comfort and elegance to everyday life. This is not simply printing on fabric or paper. It is an attempt to breathe life into Levan Margiani’s works, turning art into a quiet atmosphere and a daily experience.

Each piece is created with respect for every detail of the original work — preserving its symbolism, warmth, rhythm, and emotion. Artiani turns miniature into atmosphere: what once lived on the wall now begins to live beside us.
page.delivery.title: Payment and delivery
page.delivery.body:
Artiani orders can be paid either by bank transfer or on delivery. After you place an order, you will see the next payment step on screen and receive the same guidance by email.

Below is a short guide to payment, delivery, and order tracking.
page.delivery.section.transfer.title: How payment works
page.delivery.section.transfer.body:
You can choose either bank transfer or payment to the courier on delivery. If you choose bank transfer, please use one of the bank accounts shown at checkout and include your order code as the transfer reference.

If you choose payment on delivery, the courier collects the payment when the order arrives.
page.delivery.section.delivery.title: Delivery timing and fee
page.delivery.section.delivery.body:
Delivery in Tbilisi costs 5 GEL and usually takes about 3–4 working days.

Delivery to regions costs 10 GEL and usually takes about 5–6 working days.
page.delivery.section.tracking.title: Tracking your order
page.delivery.section.tracking.bodyPrima: You can track your order with your order code and your email or phone number.
page.delivery.section.tracking.bodySecon: you can follow the current stage of your order, including payment method, awaiting payment, processing, and shipping updates.
page.returns.title: Returns and exchanges
page.returns.body: We want every Artiani piece to arrive in the right condition and feel at home in your space. If something is not as expected, write to us first and we will review the issue with care.
page.returns.section.eligibility.title: What may be returned or exchanged
page.returns.section.eligibility.body:
Undamaged items may usually be considered for return or exchange if they were delivered in standard condition and your request is made within the stated timeframe.

If you are unsure whether your item qualifies, send us the order code and a short note first.
page.returns.section.timeframe.title: Request timeframe
page.returns.section.timeframe.body:
Please contact us within 5 days of delivery if you want to request a return or exchange.

Early contact helps us review the order while delivery details and item condition are still clear.
page.returns.section.condition.title: Condition of returned items
page.returns.section.condition.body: Items should be undamaged, clean, and returned in the same condition in which they arrived.
page.returns.section.exceptions.title: Items that are usually not returned
page.returns.section.exceptions.body:
Original paintings, clearly custom pieces, used items, and any item returned in altered condition are usually not eligible for return.

If an exception is needed because the item was received with a problem, we will review it individually.
page.returns.section.damaged.title: If an item arrives damaged
page.returns.section.damaged.body:
If your order arrives damaged or incorrect, please email us as soon as possible with your order code and clear photos.

We will review the issue and guide you toward replacement, exchange, or refund as appropriate.
page.returns.section.contact.title: How to request a return
page.returns.section.contact.body: Please send return or exchange requests to app.droze@gmail.com and include your order code, the reason for the request, and any relevant photos.
